description: The Fire Tiger in Chinese astrology: personality, Fire element traits, 1926 and 1986 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Fire Tiger is the Tiger born in a Fire year, one of five versions of the third animal. It combines the Tiger's courage with Fire's qualities. Fire Tiger years between 1924 and 2044 are 1926 and 1986. The Tiger's fixed element is Wood.

sections.heading: The Fire Tiger personality
paragraphs: The Fire Tiger is traditionally regarded as one of the most dynamic combinations in the cycle. The Tiger's fixed element is Wood, and Wood generates Fire, so the animal feeds the year element directly, producing a blaze of energy, charisma and daring. Fire Tigers are often described as passionate, theatrical and fearless, drawn to adventure and to causes that stir the heart. They tend to lead from the front, speak with conviction and inspire loyalty through sheer enthusiasm. The generating flow gives them remarkable vitality but can also burn through reserves quickly, and their impulsiveness may lead them into conflicts or risks that a moment's reflection would have avoided. In company they are rarely overlooked.

Fire is the element of summer and full daylight, and a Fire year is traditionally said to turn up the volume of whatever animal it meets. Descriptions link it with passion, charisma, courage and a love of movement and expression. Fire-year people are often portrayed as lively, persuasive and quick to act, able to warm a room and rally others behind an idea. The element is associated with the heart and with joy, which gives it real generosity of spirit. Its traditional shadow is impatience: Fire can burn hot and fast, leading to restlessness, sharp words in the moment and a tendency to lose interest once the excitement fades.

sections.heading: Fire Tiger at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Fire is usually linked with initiative, persuasion and visible leadership. Fire-year people are often described as the ones who launch things, pitch ideas and keep morale high when a deadline looms, which suits performance, sales, media, entrepreneurship and campaigning of every kind. They tend to thrive on momentum and recognition. The traditional caution concerns stamina and follow-through: a Fire stem may lose patience with routine detail, so pairing with methodical colleagues and pacing energy across a project usually helps.

A Fire Tiger at work resembles a weather front: dramatic, energising and impossible to ignore. Tradition links this blend with entrepreneurship, emergency response, performance, activism and high-stakes sales, roles that reward nerve and fast decisions. Slow approval chains frustrate it badly; owning a clear mission suits it far better, and a meticulous deputy keeps the brilliance from burning out by Thursday. In love the Fire Tiger is extravagant, given to grand gestures and fierce protectiveness. Admiration and room to roam are what it asks, along with a partner secure enough not to cling. Clashes usually follow impulsiveness: a sudden decision about money, a job offer or moving house, announced over dinner rather than discussed beforehand.

sections.heading: Fire Tiger years and dates
paragraphs: Between 1924 and 2044 the Fire Tiger years are 1926 (February 13, 1926 to February 1, 1927) and 1986 (February 9, 1986 to January 28, 1987). Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1926 anyone born before Feb 13 is a Wood Ox, not a Fire Tiger. The combination returns every sixty years, since five elements cycle through twelve animals and only meet the same pairing again after five rounds of the zodiac. Every Fire Tiger year is Yang, matching the Tiger's own polarity.

Chinese almanacs call the combination Bing-Yin, joining the heavenly stem Bing to the earthly branch Yin. Births just before each new year fall in the Wood Ox year (before February 13, 1926) and the Wood Ox year (before February 9, 1986), and births in the weeks after each Fire Tiger year ends belong to the Fire Rabbit. The new year itself fell on a Saturday in 1926 and Sunday in 1986.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Fire Tiger
paragraphs: For the Fire Tiger, the growth edge is sustaining the flame. Readings often suggest building deliberate pauses into a busy life, since this combination tends to run until it collapses. Thinking a decision overnight before acting on it can save considerable trouble. Fire Tigers may also need to share credit and listen to quieter voices, as their brightness can overshadow others without meaning to. Steady routines around sleep and food help maintain energy. When the Fire Tiger learns that patience can be a form of courage, its natural leadership becomes both bold and wise.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Fire Tiger shares the Tiger's San He trine with the Horse and Dog (the Fire trine), its Liu He bond with the Pig, and its Liu Chong clash with the Monkey. The element adds a second layer: another Fire sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Fire in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Fire Tiger years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1926 (from February 13, 1926) and 1986 (from February 9, 1986). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Fire Tiger's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Fire and the Tiger's fixed element is Wood; in the five-element cycles wood generates Fire. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Fire Tiger?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Horse and Dog (San He) and the Pig (Liu He). The Monkey is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Fire Tiger called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Bing-Yin. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Fire stem Bing, followed by its earthly branch, here Yin for the Tiger, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Fire Tiger different from other Tigers?
faq.answer: All Tigers share courage, independence and magnetic energy. The Fire year element changes the tone: fire is the element of summer and full daylight, and a Fire year is traditionally said to turn up the volume of whatever animal it meets.
